posts.name: Paul
posts.cooked:
I wanted to thank everyone who came out and supported us at PAX Australia! It was a fantastic show, and we'll definitely be back next year. I especially want to thank Andy and Spouse, who flew all the way to Australia to help us out. I also want to thank Hanna, who spent the majority of her convention, the very first PAX in Australia, helping out at our booth. She is super awesome!

 

We had a great time in Australia, and it was awesome to meet so many Sentinels fans, even though we'd traveled a hemisphere away from anywhere we've visited before.
